annotations.title: Get EU Grants from the European Commission

description: Get European Commission grants awarded directly to a Polish company (Horizon Europe, LIFE, Erasmus+ and other EU programmes from the EU Financial Transparency System). Identify the company by name, KRS number or company tax number (NIP).

krs.description: KRS number of the company in the Polish National Court Register (10 digits).

name.description: Company name, used when the KRS or NIP is not known.

nip.description: Polish company tax number (NIP) of the business, 10 digits.

name: get_company_eu_grants
